metadata.request_id: exactly 32 lowercase ASCII hex characters, server-generated provenance is caller obligation

execution.process: same caller; preserve canonical transaction/context guards
execution.dynamic_repo: MixerHosted.Repo.get_dynamic_repo() === MixerHosted.Repo before and after; refuse, never reset
execution.connection: fresh local Plug.Conn; owner nil; no outer connection
execution.query_encoding: URI.encode_www_form/1 exactly once per exact string value
defaults: ConfiguredVerifier / registered default KeyOwner / actual Unix clock
MixerHosted.Repo / ordinary current identity and membership RLS / commit checks
execution.whole_dispatch_timeout_claim: none; preserve existing component bounds; later HTTP lifecycle budget qualification pending

capture.safe_projection: exact status/headers/body map only; never return conn, assigns, private, adapter payload, credential, identity, callable or ticket

response.body_policy: No alternate successful page decoder; canonical controller owns validation. Existing BoundedJSON has a 64-array-element ceiling and must not reject legitimate 100-row pages here.
response.meaning: captured ordinary outcome, not session readiness or reusable authority

redaction: No intentional output/log/persistence/inspection/telemetry of token, private conn, identity or caught dependency details; fixed local error atoms only; no BEAM zeroization claim
head: No method argument. Later accepted outer GET/HEAD routing owns HEAD body suppression; no new route in this slice.
future_host_scope: pure codec and canonical request admission using labelled synthetic identities
adapter/canonical-controller composition using labelled trusted facade fixtures
public dispatcher negative/default-owner-absent path only, no network or Repo success
explicit frozen ordinary dependency closure; no shared ambiguous app beams
pending: actual exact default verifier/default Repo successful join
accepted callback Unit A and ClaimOwner/lifecycle composition
smaller_alternative: Pure typed Request codec only, same closed validation/serialization contract; no identity/database/callback dependency
prohibited_in_this_lane: interrupted callback Unit A review or PG16 harness reads/execution/equivalent rerun
